questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a coverage refusal from CNSS for an ALD patient. Dr. Nadia advises him to appeal the decision. According to Article 24 of Law 65-00, what recourse is possible?
options: A judicial appeal before the court
A complaint to the council of the order
A request for revision by the ministry
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The administrative appeal to CNSS is the first step before any judicial appeal.' Dr. Karim: 'I will prepare the appeal file.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia discovers that her assistant has been paid without AMO contributions for 6 months. Dr. Karim reminds her of the employer's obligations. According to Article 130 of Law 65-00, what fine does the employer incur who fails to register?
options: A prison sentence of 6 months to 2 years
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 130 provides for a fine of 5,000 to 50,000 dirhams for the employer who fails to register.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will immediately regularize the situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who filed a complaint for poor coverage. Dr. Nadia advises him to check the documents. According to Article 14 of Law 65-00, what fundamental right does the AMO beneficiary retain?
options: The right to choose only in the public sector
Free choice of practitioner and healthcare establishment
Obligation to consult the designated attending physician
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 14 guarantees the beneficiary free choice of practitioner, healthcare establishment, pharmacist, and paramedical professional.' Dr. Karim: 'I will respect this fundamental right.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who has changed family situation. Dr. Karim advises her to update the file. According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, who are the dependents covered by AMO?
options: The spouse, children under 21, and disabled children
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 5 defines dependents as: the spouse, children under 21 (26 for students), and disabled children without age limit.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will update the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who underwent aesthetic surgery. Dr. Nadia asks him not to bill AMO. According to Article 8 of Law 65-00, why is this procedure not reimbursable?
options: Because it is an aesthetic procedure
Because it is a painful procedure
Because it is an experimental procedure
Because it is a non-agreed procedure
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 8 clearly excludes aesthetic surgery from the scope of AMO.' Dr. Karim: 'I will inform the patient that they will have to pay for this procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia finds that CNSS has refused reimbursement for a patient with diabetes. Dr. Karim advises her to check the list of ALDs. According to Law 65-00, is diabetes an ALD entitling to exemption?
options: No, diabetes is not an ALD
Yes, but only for hospitalized patients
No, only dental conditions are ALDs
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Diabetes is an ALD recognized by Law 65-00, entitling to exemption from the ticket modérateur.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will send the certificate to CNSS.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must send documents to CNSS for a patient. Dr. Nadia advises him to respect the deadlines. According to Article 20 of Law 65-00, what is the deadline for submitting invoices?
options: Set by the regulations in force
Only two years after the procedure
Imposed by the Ministry of Health
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The prescription period for invoices is strictly regulated.' Dr. Karim: 'I will respect the deadlines to avoid any refusal.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who lost their job. Dr. Karim advises her to check their rights. According to Article 34 of Law 65-00, how long does a person retain their rights after ceasing to work?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 34 provides for retention of rights for a maximum period of six months after cessation of activity.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will inform my patient of their rights.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must prepare an estimate for a patient benefiting from AMO. Dr. Nadia reminds him of the billing rules. According to Law 65-00, must the dentist inform the patient of the agreed tariffs?
options: No, the secret is kept by the doctor
Yes, the patient must know the tariffs
Yes, only by the AMO manager
No, this is not stipulated by law
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Transparency of tariffs is mandatory for any contracted dentist.' Dr. Karim: 'I will provide a detailed estimate to my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who consulted without being registered. Dr. Karim advises her to check their status. According to Article 2 of Law 65-00, to which categories of persons does AMO apply?
options: Civil servants, employees, pensioners, self-employed workers, and students
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'AMO applies to all these categories: civil servants, employees, pensioners, self-employed, liberal professionals, students, and former resistance members.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will check my patient's situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who was hospitalized abroad in an emergency. Dr. Nadia advises him to check the reimbursement conditions. According to Article 13 of Law 65-00, under what condition are care abroad reimbursed?
options: If the patient is on a business trip
If care cannot be provided in Morocco with prior agreement
If the patient is of Moroccan nationality
If the patient has taken out complementary insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Care abroad is reimbursed in case of unexpected illness or when care cannot be provided in Morocco, with prior agreement.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check if there was prior agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia receives an ANAM audit notification concerning her activity. Dr. Karim advises her to prepare. According to Article 26 of Law 65-00, what is the purpose of the control?
options: Verify the number of patients per day
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'The control aims to verify the conformity of prescriptions and the validity of benefits.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will prepare all my files.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who has taken out complementary insurance. Dr. Nadia asks him to coordinate reimbursements. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, what is the rule regarding complementary insurance?
options: The insured person cannot take out complementary insurance
The insured person remains free to take out complementary insurance
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 9 specifies that the insured person remains free to take out complementary insurance.' Dr. Karim: 'I will coordinate the two coverages.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia discovers that an employee has not been declared to CNSS. Dr. Karim reminds her of the sanctions. According to Article 131 of Law 65-00, what is the fine for each unregistered employee?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 131 provides for a fine of 1,000 dirhams for each unregistered employee.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will immediately declare my employee.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who received care without following the care pathway. Dr. Nadia advises him to check the attending physician rule. According to Law 65-00, must the patient necessarily go through an attending physician?
options: No, the patient can consult a dentist directly
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'AMO allows the patient to consult a dentist directly without going through an attending physician.' Dr. Karim: 'I will inform my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia must bill care to a patient with mutual insurance and AMO. Dr. Karim advises her to respect the agreed tariffs. According to Law 65-00, what is the base tariff for reimbursement?
options: The free tariff chosen by the practitioner
The maximum tariff allowed in emergencies
The reduced tariff for low-income patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'National pricing serves as the AMO reference for reimbursement of care.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will apply the national tariff.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim has a patient who refused to pay the ticket modérateur. Dr. Nadia reminds him of the AMO rules. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, is the ticket modérateur mandatory?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'The ticket modérateur is mandatory except for ALD which benefit from exemption.' Dr. Karim: 'I will explain this to my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia finds that a patient has received an undue reimbursement. Dr. Karim advises her to report the error. According to Article 135 of Law 65-00, what does a person who obtains undue benefits risk?
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 135 punishes fraud or false declaration to obtain undue benefits with a fine of 1,000 to 5,000 dirhams.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will report the error.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim receives a patient who has benefited from long-term hospitalization. Dr. Nadia advises him to check the coverage. According to Law 65-00, are rehabilitation care covered?
options: No, only curative care are covered
Yes, but only for patients over 60
No, rehabilitation is at the patient's expense
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Article 7 covers rehabilitation, maternity, and dental care.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check the coverage.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who lost their insurance card. Dr. Karim advises her to check their registration number. According to Article 2 of Law 65-00, who is required to register with AMO?
options: Any person exercising an activity in Morocco
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Registration is mandatory for any person exercising an activity in Morocco.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will help my patient find their number.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim must manage a complex ALD patient file with exemption. Dr. Nadia advises him to follow the procedure. According to Article 9 of Law 65-00, how does exemption operate in case of serious illness?
options: Total or partial exemption from the ticket modérateur
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'In case of serious or disabling illness requiring long-term care, the remaining portion is exempted totally or partially.' Dr. Karim: 'I will follow the procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who wishes to consult another dentist. Dr. Karim reminds her of the principle of free choice. According to Article 14 of Law 65-00, can the patient change dentists freely?
options: No, they must stay with the same dentist
Yes, the patient can change freely
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'Article 14 guarantees the beneficiary free choice of practitioner.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will respect this fundamental right.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim finds that his practice has been audited by CNSS. Dr. Nadia asks him to check the documents. According to Article 26 of Law 65-00, what can medical control identify?
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Medical control can identify abuses and fraud in prescriptions.' Dr. Karim: 'I will check that everything is in order.'

questions.question: Dr. Nadia has a patient who benefits from RAMED. Dr. Karim advises her to check the conditions. According to Article 3 of Law 65-00, who is RAMED intended for?
options: Economically disadvantaged persons not subject to AMO
questions.explanation: Dr. Karim explains: 'RAMED is intended for economically disadvantaged persons who do not benefit from any AMO scheme.' Dr. Nadia: 'I will check if my patient meets the conditions.'

questions.question: Dr. Karim, after managing several disputes with CNSS, receives congratulations from Dr. Nadia. What is the next step for Dr. Karim?
options: Become an expert in agreement disputes
questions.explanation: Dr. Nadia explains: 'Mastery of disputes is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert in agreement disputes is the next step.' Dr. Karim: 'I will train in appeals management.'
